query:
SELECT id, name, email, procurementRole, approvalLevel, phone, extraRoles, extraApprovalLevels
FROM users
WHERE procurementRole = 'diretoria' OR approvalLevel = 'diretoria'
   OR name ILIKE '%rafael%' OR name ILIKE '%liberato%'
ORDER BY name;
